title: Planning Objective
description: What a plan optimizes for. Alone it steers the plan inside the budget (budget_mode set) or the sizing of it (suggest); beside a delivery_target it chooses among plans that meet the target. The seller reports the resulting figures in plan_breakdown.

enumDescriptions.max_reach: Maximize unduplicated audience reached within the plan's constraints. Reach is counted in the plan's audience_basis.reach_unit.
enumDescriptions.max_efficiency: Minimize cost per delivered unit: cost per point (CPP) when the plan carries grps, otherwise cost per thousand impressions (CPM).
